answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 48293 Country: India Title: Baby Name Question: I am blessed with son on 2nd September 2013, we thought the name to be "MOHAMMED YAQOOB ZAYD". Is this name good meaning if not can you suggest some alternative name. Answer ID: 48293 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1457/1120/B=11/1434) Just keep the name Muhammad Yaqoob. There is no need to add Zaid. This is a good name. It is the name of a prophet. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
